Support the gallery

To keep our doors open & free to the public, we rely on the financial support from individuals, trusts and foundations to present an ambitious programme of exhibitions, screening, events and learning activities, in addition to the core funding from Arts Council England and Southwark Council.

There are many ways of supporting us; starting or building your own art collections by purchasing artworks or limited editions from our online shop, sponsoring a project, donations, or becoming a member of our supporter’s circle

The Sparkle, The Blossom and The Milky Land
DanFong Wang

15 August – 1 November 2026   //   Lake Gallery Preview:  Friday 14 August, 6 – 8pm Exhibition Open:  Wednesday – Sunday, 12 – 5pm

Through moving image, textile and sculpture, Taiwanese artist DanFong Wang presents her first UK solo exhibition that draws on feminist theory and cultural rituals to explore female labor, the body and spiritual transformation.

For ‘The Sparkle, The Blossom and The Milky Land’, DanFong presents her 2024 animation of the same title with new embroidery work and soft sculpture referencing Catholic and Buddhist funerary practices to explore themes of gender and motherhood. By contrasting and comparing both Eastern and Western religious systems, DanFong reflects on how women are positioned through ideas of sacrifice, purity and reproduction.

DanFong was selected by independent curator A—Z (Anne Duffau) as the winner of our 41st Annual Open in 2025, London’s longest-running democratic exhibition and a rare opportunity for all artists at any stage of their career to submit work without a selection criteria.

This exhibition is generously supported by Breckman & Company and Arts Council England.

Submissions for Annual Open 2026 launch in September, please check our website for updates.

 

Artist Bio

DanFong Wang (b. 1993, Taiwan; based London) received her MA in Craft! from Konstfack University of Arts, Crafts and Design in Stockholm. Her works have been screened and exhibited internationally, including Toronto Indie Short, Canada (2022); Montreal Independent Film Festival, Canada (2022); BLON Animation Festival, Lithuanian (2025); and Southwark Park Galleries in London, where she was awarded the 2025 Annual Open Winner.
